title: Avatar with initials fallback and badges
when: The user wants user avatars, initials when there is no photo, status dots or count badges.
prompt: Goal: Avatars that never break: photo when available, initials otherwise, and badges whose meaning is in text. Steps: 1. Photo: with width, height, border-radius: 50% and object-fit: cover; alt is the name, or alt="" when the name is printed next to it. 2. Fallback: a span with the first letters of the first and last word, uppercased, aria-hidden, with the name in visually hidden text. 3. Pick the background from a hash of the name over six token colors that all pass 4.5 to 1 with the text. 4. An image error listener (addEventListener("error")) swaps a broken photo for the initials. 5. Sizes as modifier classes (24, 32, 48, 96 px). A status dot carries visually hidden text Online. 6. Count badges cap at 99+ and the button name says the count: Notifications, 3 unread. Quality bar: - Every badge meaning is in text. - Initials are centered and sized to the circle. - Same name, same color every time. Pitfalls: - Inline onerror attributes. - Status shown by color only. - Badges built with innerHTML from names. Verify: - [ ] Images have alt, width and height. - [ ] Broken photos fall back to initials. - [ ] Status and counts are in text. - [ ] Names are inserted with textContent. Output: Avatar and badge markup patterns, avatar.css and avatar.js.

examples.input: avatar com iniciais quando o usuario nao tem foto
examples.output: round 48 px photos, initials AL on a hashed color when missing, green dot with hidden Online text
